headline: По полисам ОСАГО в Кыргызстане страховщики выплатили 471,4 миллиона сомов
summary: Insurers paid 471.4 million soms under OSAGO motor liability policies in Kyrgyzstan. Motor-related compensation made up 56.3% of total insurance payouts of 1.7 billion soms over nine months of 2026.
why: OSAGO is Kyrgyzstan's compulsory motor third-party liability insurance, so its payout levels show the size and claims activity of the country's motor insurance market.
